scope: Finite static read-only client metadata qualification; only the two expressly owned new paths written. No client/installer/DLL code executed; no connections, GRF parsing, decryption, protection analysis or account-state inspection.

pe.bounds: DOS pointer, COFF, optional header, section table/raw spans and selected directory RVAs checked against actual file length

identity.confidence: High for actual PE offsets/x86 format/hash and absent readable RT_VERSION fixed data under the bounded parser. No protocol identity inferred from COFF time, filename, import libraries, old Lua errors, or existing server profile. Static visible DLL descriptors do not exhaust dynamically loaded dependencies or reveal protocol mappings.

configuration.plugin_ini_limit: The INI-section/equal-key parser found no rows in plugin.ini. Parent-supplied earlier inspection identified graphics/LGP fields. This is not a claim that the file is empty. No values were extracted or published.
configuration.actual_executable_supported_lookup: UNKNOWN: no official uaRO private-server connection-file selection or override contract established. Creating XML is not proof this executable will read it.
configuration.public_generic_shape: rAthena documents clientinfo XML connection address/port/version. XML version matches login client_version_to_connect, not the protocol PACKETVER. This generic document does not establish uaRO support or authorization.

resources.completeness: Historical official-uaRO world entry in the preserved lab establishes operational usability for that supplied server/runtime combination, not completeness for every map or compatibility with an own server.
resources.base_vs_overlay: data.grf is a candidate large base archive with known nonstandard Event Horizon/0x300 header. uaro.grf/uaro2.grf are candidate uaRO overlays with known Master of Magic/0x200 headers, but content/completeness and base dependency are UNVERIFIED. The 643-byte extra GRF is inventoried and hashed only. Names/sizes/standard header do not prove self-contained resources or licensed reuse.
resources.unsupported_boundary: The base format is NOT QUALIFIED for another executable or any stock reader. No corruption verdict and no universal unsupported-format claim; no index/content parsing, decryption or keys.

protection.local_boundary: Only public root filename/size metadata establishes gepard.dll/gepard.license/gepard.register presence. No contents of these files read; no server-auth strings, keys or anti-cheat mechanisms inspected.
protection.official_public_evidence: Official uaRO troubleshooting documents a Gepard server-license validation error. That shows a possible additional runtime licensing dependency, not a private-server entitlement or implementation contract.
protection.pair_status: UNKNOWN: authorized vendor/server-owner support must establish licensing and supported server integration for this exact client. Stock rAthena acceptance has NOT been established. No invented license-compatible component, DNS/hosts redirect, handshake spoof, client modification or bypass.

reusable_without_original_changes.runtime_recipe: Separate historical uaRO GE-Proton11-7/UMU lab recipe has official-uaRO world-entry evidence. User RagnarokOnline GE-Proton9-27 + steam-run-free flake is a different runtime-only recipe, not a client bundle.
